milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the black concrete 2x2x2 structure (centered at spawn-relative 5.5, 0.5, 5.5 in the SE corner) and face it, demonstrating they have located it. Max distance of 8 blocks and 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining red_concrete_powder drops the item into the player's inventory. Although the player is given 16 via /give at scene setup, the mine_block event would be ideal but is not a supported rule type. Instead, we check inventory_has with min_count=17 — since the player starts with exactly 16, having 17+ proves they mined at least one block from the world. This reliably detects the mining action.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a build/place task. The player must place blocks on top of the stone platform (y=0 layer, which is one above the stone at y=-1) within the 5x5 area. Checking for at least 4 blocks of either black_concrete or red_concrete_powder placed in a generous box covering the platform area. Box extends ±3 in X and ±3 around center Z=5 to be generous, and y=0 to y=1 to catch blocks placed on the surface.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a build/place task. A Minecraft chair is minimally one oak_stairs block placed as a seat. The player must place at least 1 oak_stairs block within the floor/building area. Box covers the stone platform region with generous bounds (±5 XZ, y=0 to y=3) to accommodate chairs built on top of the floor layer.
